# archestra_service_account (Data Source)

Finds a service account by its exact name. Use `id` as the `subject_id` of a `serviceAccount` grant, or wherever a service account ID is expected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A service account created outside this configuration, found by name.
data "archestra_service_account" "ci" {
  name = "ci-deploy"
}

# Let it run an agent, without pasting its ID.
resource "archestra_agent" "release_notes" {
  name          = "Release notes"
  system_prompt = "Write release notes from the merged pull requests."

  permissions = [{
    subject_type = "serviceAccount"
    subject_id   = data.archestra_service_account.ci.id
    actions      = ["read", "use"]
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact name of the service account.

### Read-Only

- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the service account is disabled.
- `id` (String) Service account ID.
- `role` (String) Role of the service account.
- `team_id` (String) Team the service account belongs to, when it has one.
